name: Paint roller
summary: Paint roller with a painted sleeve, yoke, pole and T-grip; for decorating, painting walls and home makeover scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the sleeve rests on the floor at y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 480 px tall); use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: roll = stripes run across the sleeve as if it is rolling
